title: Agent Configuration v1
description: Configuration contract for consumer repositories. Loaded from .github/agent.config.yml.

name.description: Application name used for LLM client metadata and OpenRouter attribution headers. Falls back to the repository name derived from GITHUB_REPOSITORY.

base_branch.description: Source branch used for agent checkouts and base-branch sync.

pr_target.description: Target branch for agent-created pull requests. Defaults to git.base_branch.

branch_prefix.description: Prefix for agent-created branches, e.g. agent/<issue#>-<slug>.

merge_strategy.description: Default strategy used when synchronizing with the base branch.

plan.description: Model used for the /agent plan phase.

implement.description: Model used for the /agent implement and /agent yolo phases.

fix.description: Model used for /agent fix and CI auto-fix (overrides ci-fix and review-fix when set).

ci-fix.description: Deprecated alias for models.fix — used when fix is unset.

review-fix.description: Deprecated alias for models.fix — used when fix is unset (review-fix takes precedence over ci-fix).

ask.description: Model used for the /agent ask phase.

code-review.description: Model used for the /agent code-review phase.

prompts.description: Per-phase system prompt overrides. Each phase can override the role description that appears at the start of the system prompt; the operational instructions remain fixed.

role_description.description: Role description for the plan phase.
role_description.default: You are a planning agent for this repository.

role_description.description: Role description for the implement phase.
role_description.default: You are an implementation agent for this repository.

role_description.description: Role description for the ci-fix phase.
role_description.default: You are a CI fix agent for this repository.

role_description.description: Role description for the yolo phase.
role_description.default: You are an implementation agent for this repository.

role_description.description: Role description for the review-fix phase.
role_description.default: You are a review fix agent for this repository.

role_description.description: Role description for the ask phase.
role_description.default: You are a Q&A agent for this repository.

role_description.description: Role description for the code-review phase.
role_description.default: You are a code review agent for this repository.

max_rounds.description: Maximum number of automatic CI fix rounds before blocking the PR.

run_commands_timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each command in the Cline run_commands tool.

openrouter.description: Optional OpenRouter-specific settings for the agent runtime.

jev_router.description: Optional Jev Router mode (OpenRouter model typesafe/jev-router). When enabled for a phase, the configured phase model slug is used as the default candidate pool unless models/allowed_models are set.

enabled.description: Enable Jev Router globally. Per-phase overrides live under phases.

metadata.description: Send X-OpenRouter-Metadata: enabled on requests when Jev Router is active.

models.description: Include list (wildcard patterns allowed). Merged with allowed_models.

allowed_models.description: Alias of models; entries are combined with models.

phases.description: Per-phase Jev Router overrides (enabled flag and optional pool lists).

code_review.description: Optional scope and instructions for the /agent code-review phase. When omitted, reviews.path_filters and reviews.path_instructions from .coderabbit.yaml are used as fallback.

path_filters.description: Glob patterns; leading ! excludes paths (CodeRabbit-compatible semantics).

apply_default_ignores.description: When true, append default ignores (lockfiles, node_modules, dist).

follow_up.description: Follow-up behavior when /agent code-review runs again on the same PR.

resolve_threads.description: agent_only: triage and resolve open threads from the agent bot; all_authors: include human review threads; off: skip follow-up tooling and context.
